title: CppCon 2014: Herb Sutter "Back to the Basics! Essentials of Modern C++ Style"
summary: Herb Sutter revisits basic C++ questions in light of C++11 and C++14: how to declare and initialize variables, pass values to functions, write loops, and use smart pointers. It covers auto, rvalue references, range-for, uniform initialization, lambdas, unique_ptr and shared_ptr.
why: HN people list it among the go-to talks for learning or refreshing modern C++ style, and cite it for Sutter's guidance on function parameter passing.
